note: Named major projects for the future-value 'catalysts' driver. Positions are APPROXIMATE (district or site centre picked by hand, ~200-500 m); km = rough reach used to decide 'near this flat'. year = opening / start year as published (null = long-term, no date). Only facts read from the source_url (or the official page it cites) are recorded; re-check when URA / MOH / HDB announce changes.

projects.name: Punggol Digital District
projects.note: JTC business district + SIT campus at Punggol Coast; opened progressively from Q3 2024.

projects.name: Jurong Lake District
projects.note: Largest business district outside the Central Area (URA Master Plan 2025, West region); developed over decades.

projects.name: Paya Lebar Air Base redevelopment
projects.note: Air base relocates from the 2030s; new town of up to 150,000 homes announced at National Day Rally 2022; height limits around it may be lifted. Adds supply as well as amenities.

projects.name: Greater Southern Waterfront (Keppel Club site)
projects.note: Waterfront from Pasir Panjang to Marina East freed up as the ports move to Tuas; first precincts (Keppel Club, Pasir Panjang Power District) within about 5-10 years.

projects.name: Bukit Timah Turf City
projects.note: URA (2024): new estate of about 15,000-20,000 public and private homes over 20-30 years; served by Sixth Avenue (DTL) and a future Cross Island Line station.

projects.name: Woodlands Health Campus
projects.note: Acute + community hospital (NHG) at 17 Woodlands Drive 17; opened progressively, officially opened 13 July 2024.

projects.name: Eastern General Hospital
projects.note: SingHealth general + community hospital next to Bedok North MRT (DTL), bounded by Bedok Reservoir Rd and Bedok North Rd; expected around 2029-2030.

projects.name: Tengah hospital (integrated general + community)
projects.note: MOH Committee of Supply 2024: new NUHS hospital in Tengah, completion in the early 2030s (year shown = earliest). Exact site not published - placed at Tengah town centre.

projects.name: Bidadari estate (Bidadari Park, Woodleigh Mall)
projects.note: New HDB estate on the former cemetery: first flats 2019, Woodleigh Mall 2023, 10-ha Bidadari Park opened September 2024 (secondary source).
projects.source_note: NParks release (3 Sep 2024): Bidadari Park and Alkaff Lake newly opened, on the former Bidadari Cemetery (sets year = 2024). URA 'Transformation of Bidadari into A Community in a Garden' (ura.gov.sg Ideas and Trends): 10 ha park, 12 BTO projects / 8,872 flats since the first launch in Nov 2015. First flats 2019 and Woodleigh Mall 2023 are not on an official page (secondary). Replaces Wikipedia, checked 2026-10-09.
